name: facebook100_exact_reference_tail
notes: Reconstruction configuration; no original trained weights or unreleased pool IDs are claimed.
The generic exact-reference-tail backend performs full continuation checks and has different compute costs from the native arxiv tube backend.

Penn94 to Caltech36 is a declared example assignment, not an author-recovered university pair. The manuscript names GCNII but omits these domains and detailed architecture. T=16, width 128, alpha, lambda and source split settings are explicit reconstruction choices. Changing the universities defines a new frozen experiment.
Full: 512 calibration calls per configured depth per member, 512 selection calls per member, and 2048 final audit calls; smoke uses explicitly synthetic fixtures.
